answer:
I'd like an all-male Ichiban Kuji too! Especially the figures...!

The reason is that when I received flowers for Otto's birthday, I usually take photos of them alongside character figures and things like that, but there weren't any Otto goods, so I didn't know what to do...

There are acrylic keychains and things like that, but as I mentioned earlier, I've stopped accepting merchandise...
